verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site directly claims you can "Email or upload receipts and we'll auto-attach them to the right card transaction," which matches the story exactly. Supporting evidence includes an API endpoint to upload a transaction attachment, API write actions for uploading receipts, and an official mercury-receipt-upload agent skill. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on the email-forwarding workflow and matching logic (including how unmatched receipts are handled), and independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-matching works reliably.
